newsitem.title: USA: Chubb insurance, real estate sale seen - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Chubb insurance, real estate sale seen - NYT.

text.p: Chubb Corp is expected to announce the sale of its life insurance business and a majority portion of its real estate business in the next few days, the New York Times reported on Monday.

Chubb, which has been exploring the sale of both businesses, is finalizing a deal to sell Chubb Life to Jefferson-Pilot of Greensboro, North Carolina, for $850 to $900 million, people close to the talks told the newspaper.

The report said Chubb was also in final negotiations with Dallas' Patriot American Hospitality Inc and Boston's Beacon Properties Corp to sell 80 percent of its real estate business for about $1 billion, including debt.
The report said it is uncertain which company will win the deal for Chubb's real estate unit, Bellemead Development Corp, but that announcements could come as early as Monday.
